title: Rua das Lâmpadas
source: Hallways Originals: Rua das Lâmpadas (lab/genres/bossa.py, bossa_vocal.py), developed into a full piece Oct 25 2026

parts.name: Bass
parts.description: Roots and fifths, anticipating; a melodic walk in the bass break.

parts.name: Bossa chords
parts.description: The guitar's syncopated two-bar bossa chords.

parts.name: Percussion
parts.description: Congas, shaker, claves; bongos under the solos; the shaker alone in the bass break.

parts.name: Melody
parts.description: The tune; one-bar calls in the trading B; the lift into E; the tag.

parts.name: Answers
parts.description: Little replies in the tune's long notes -- and a solo over an A.

parts.name: Harmony
parts.description: A line under the tune -- and a solo of its own.

parts.name: Held chords
parts.description: Soft held chords under the B sections, the solos and the ending.
